description: Explore essential mathematical concepts through carefully crafted questions. Strengthen your understanding, practice your reasoning, and learn at your own pace.

questions.learningObjective: Determine the truth value of a compound Boolean statement built from two given propositions.
questions.question: Let \(P\): "2 is an even number" and \(Q\): "3 is a prime number". Given these facts, which of the following compound statements is FALSE?
questions.explanation: Since "2 is an even number" is True, \(P = \text{True}\); since "3 is a prime number" is True, \(Q = \text{True}\). Evaluating \(\neg Q\) gives FALSE, so option B is the correct answer.
